name: Arnoldo Mondadori Editore S.p.A.
summary: Arnoldo Mondadori Editore S.p.A., together with its subsidiaries, engages in publishing of books and magazines in Italy, rest of Europe, the United States, internationally. The company offers fiction, non-fiction, poetry, classics, children, and young adult books; art catalogues; comics, e-books, audiobooks, luxury, and paperback; and textbooks, courses, teaching aids, and multimedia content for all levels of education. It also engages in the publishing of works on art, architecture, exhibition catalogs, museum guides, and sponsored books, as well as managing museum concessions and organizing exhibitions and cultural events. The company offers its products under the Mondadori, Giulio Einaudi…
